input.quote: 5.3 Any of the Parties may at its own expense insure against risks so far as its own share of such costs is concerned. Should the Parties jointly agree to insure against risks, the costs of such insurance shall form part of the Capital Costs, as approved by the Management Committee.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no mandatory insurance covenant. Paragraph 5.3 (p0139) makes insurance wholly permissive — each Party \"may\" insure its own share, and joint insurance arises only if the Parties agree, in which case the premium becomes a Capital Cost. The cost definitions (p0133, p0141-p0142) go further and expressly contemplate a Party self-insuring, allowing \"a reasonable allowance in lieu of insurance if such Party elects to carry a risk itself\", and construction-phase damage is simply absorbed into Capital Costs (p0138), so an uninsured loss suffered by another Party is recharged in part to us. There are no minimum limits, no E&O or cyber cover and no certificate mechanic anywhere in the document, so the rule's fallback is not met on any element. We have inserted the shortest covenant that carries both fallback elements — E&O of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of at least USD 2,000,000 — imposed on the other Parties only, so as not to add a new obligation on ourselves. We targeted the fallback rather than the preferred limits (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' compensation, certificates) because this is a multilateral consortium cable agreement rather than a services or hosting engagement; the higher preferred limits and certificate mechanic remain available if the counterparties will accept them.

proposal.summary: Insert mandatory E&O and cyber insurance minimums for the other APCN 2 Parties
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 5.3 makes insurance purely optional, so an uninsured loss simply flows back to us through Capital Costs. We have added a short covenant requiring the other Parties to carry errors and omissions cover of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy cover of at least USD 2,000,000, which is our fallback insurance position.

ops.text: Each Party other than Teleglobe USA Inc. shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
